The new construction proves exactly 2K simple zero crossings by separated scales plus a real exponential-polynomial zero bound, then 2K+1 oscillation components, for every K. value.rationale: The natural number of disconnected wave-number regimes with oscillatory collective relaxation is a global invariant relevant to how multiple repulsive interaction lengths enter the linearized dynamic structure factor. The theorem constructs arbitrarily many such regimes despite completely positive smooth pair repulsion, positive Fourier transform, and linear stability; it rules out bounded-band heuristics for the explicit closure.
